correctness.rationale: Parseval diagonalizes fourth moment exactly as self-convolution energy. All collisions among six unordered pair sums are exhausted by double or midpoint equalities; combinatorial combinations force cyclic-three, cyclic-four or Klein-four. Each normalized three-weight polynomial has explicit sharp bound with achieved equality, and the order-three case follows pointwise L4/L2 inequality on the three-element quotient. Actual package checker enumerated 5790 triples, 23160 exact Gaussian-integer tests and 167 independent Fourier sum equalities; tests corroborate but do not constitute general proof. The equality phase conditions were individually reconstructed.

value.rationale: Natural complete sharp operator-norm classification for the first support size in which both arithmetic midpoint and order-two torsion collisions interact. Six distinct geometries give five sharp constants, fully quantified across all finite abelian groups, with phase-rigid equality classifications and a case where a frequency must be suppressed. Structural torsion distinctions and nonuniform optimizers are useful exact benchmarks for finite-group Lambda(4) inequalities; not asserted to imply broader restriction estimates.
